summary: BEFORE direct-dependents selection: 8 tests; AFTER transitive import-closure: 300 tests. The import graph was a CYCLE covering all 40 sources, so the closure is the whole suite — correct (direct-only would miss real transitive dependents) but useless as a selection. Same precondition as BAC-0025/0060: transitive selection needs a DAG; on cyclic graphs the full run is genuinely required.
